profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
- 6+ years of experience with C++ and Python programming, network OS development, data center networking, shell scripting, Linux kernel networking, end-to-end and unit testing, Docker, Azure Pipelines CI/CD
- Effective leadership and collaboration across multiple teams and external partners
- Experience with all stages of the feature development cycle from design to global rollout
- Highly competent at debugging and mitigation of complex issues in a production environment

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Teaching assistant for introductory level computer science course with over 500 enrolled students
- Personally supervised and led recitation sections for over 100 students
- Held office hours to thoroughly explain concepts and assist students with debugging
- Quickly and accurately graded exams, labs, and homework assignments

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented proof-of-concept for parallelized Docker-based networking stacks to onboard new multi-ASIC hardware platforms
- Worked with the Linux networking stack and system services to encapsulate and connect multiple network processing units
- Enabled run-time platform detection and configuration for the SONiC network OS by writing a custom systemd generator

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Designed model and associated mechanics for a spatial and temporal reliant social network
- Developed MVP-architecture based native Android application to pull content from a REST API

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Migrated C++/C# network services to use Protobuf and gRPC to reduce CPU usage by 80% and memory usage by 20%
- Revised and implemented new proprietary messaging standard between controller and client devices
- Designed benchmarks to compare network communication protocols and message formats
- Integrate new communication protocol and message format into existing application code
- Streamlined and containerized application build pipeline

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed benchmarking software for polygon mesh-generation methods
- Created an application to generate visualizations of point cloud data
- Implemented usability improvements to existing point cloud analysis applications
- Performed software and hardware integration testing for the CH-53K heavy-lift helicopter

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Used the Apache Lucene and Apache Tika libraries to implement a program to process tweets and correct out of vocabulary words.
- Utilized the JSoup and JDBC Java libraries to perform calculations to weight individual Amazon reviews based on personal review history and provide more accurate customer feedback to manufacturers and retailers.
- Applied the SQLite 3 Python library and language processing algorithms to execute sentiment analysis on Tweets about specific products to provide manufacturers with more precise data on public product perception

positions.title: Customer Service Associate
positions.description: - Boosted net sales by up-selling higher-end tuxedos and accessories to wedding customers, generated increased client satisfaction with exemplary customer service

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
- Instructed and supervised students working in the center
- Helped manage student curriculum through diagnostic assessments
- Provided IT support for the center and assisted with opening a new location.

volunteerExperiences.description: I exercised organizational skills by registering new donors and determining donor eligibility in addition to monitoring donors for possible side-effects.
